caveats: Assisted chassis velocity and posture; gravity compensation enabled.
Positive actuator work is mechanical work, not electrical battery energy.
Terrain exposure is a geometric and semantic difficulty proxy, not fall probability.
Controlled research graph and inspired baselines; not exact reproductions of the cited papers.
Cost averages condition on admissibility or success; compare denominators and paired cases.
Return route estimates use a common reference heading and the configured reserve allowance.
Procedurally generated physical worlds from a restricted simulated distribution; not real-world generalization.
Independently generated physical obstacle and shallow-terrain worlds from four procedural families; simulated distribution only, not real-world validation.
PSO and ACO are A* seeded waypoint refiners, not unseeded global planners.
All new optimizers share the same feasible-first composite quality and continuous collision checks.
Seed search, visibility checks and fitness evaluations count toward each method wall budget; operation counts are different primitive types.
Repeated stochastic seeds share a scene; they are not independent test maps.

metricDefinitions.label: Mission success
metricDefinitions.definition: Destination reached by deadline and return to a station completed without a battery guard or execution failure. Denominator includes all attempts, including rejected plans.

metricDefinitions.label: Mechanical work
metricDefinitions.definition: Integral of positive actuator force times actuator velocity at every physics substep for the destination and return route. Joules; not electrical battery energy.

metricDefinitions.label: Terrain exposure
metricDefinitions.definition: Path length integrated against normalized footprint-window geometric features and assumed semantic softness. Difficulty proxy; not fall probability.

metricDefinitions.label: Planning time
metricDefinitions.definition: Per-method wall time on this machine, excluding shared graph and lower-bound preprocessing. Methods share the same declared time and expansion budgets.

metricDefinitions.label: Common route quality
metricDefinitions.definition: distance/50 + time/90 + modeled battery percentage points/30 + 0.25*terrain exposure/20. Lower is better among feasible routes. New PSO ACO and proposal use this same preference.

metricDefinitions.label: Repeated trials
metricDefinitions.definition: Each method receives the same case and seed in each repetition. Repetitions share an underlying map and are not independent maps.

metricDefinitions.label: Prediction residuals
metricDefinitions.definition: Executed destination time or modeled battery use minus its planned prediction. Positive means underprediction. Simulation consistency only; no external electrical calibration.

metricDefinitions.label: Search progress
metricDefinitions.definition: Observed best feasible score improvements by elapsed wall time, including charged A* initialization. No interpolation or manufactured intermediate iterations.

caveats: Assisted chassis velocity and posture; gravity compensation enabled.
Positive actuator work is mechanical work, not electrical battery energy.
Terrain exposure is a geometric and semantic difficulty proxy, not fall probability.
Controlled research graph and inspired baselines; not exact reproductions of the cited papers.
Cost averages condition on admissibility or success; compare denominators and paired cases.
Return route estimates use a common reference heading and the configured reserve allowance.
Procedurally generated physical worlds from a restricted simulated distribution; not real-world generalization.
Independently generated physical obstacle and shallow-terrain worlds from four procedural families; simulated distribution only, not real-world validation.
PSO and ACO are A* seeded waypoint refiners, not unseeded global planners.
All new optimizers share the same feasible-first composite quality and continuous collision checks.
Seed search, visibility checks and fitness evaluations count toward each method wall budget; operation counts are different primitive types.
Repeated stochastic seeds share a scene; they are not independent test maps.

Paired comparison resamples whole independent generated worlds after averaging seeds. Route quality is conditional on joint admission; admission advantage uses all scheduled pairs. Descriptive simulation evidence, not a hardware or universal superiority claim.

metricDefinitions.label: Mission success
metricDefinitions.definition: Destination reached by deadline and return to a station completed without a battery guard or execution failure. Denominator includes all attempts, including rejected plans.

metricDefinitions.label: Mechanical work
metricDefinitions.definition: Integral of positive actuator force times actuator velocity at every physics substep for the destination and return route. Joules; not electrical battery energy.

metricDefinitions.label: Terrain exposure
metricDefinitions.definition: Path length integrated against normalized footprint-window geometric features and assumed semantic softness. Difficulty proxy; not fall probability.

metricDefinitions.label: Planning time
metricDefinitions.definition: Per-method wall time on this machine, excluding shared graph and lower-bound preprocessing. Methods share the same declared time and expansion budgets.

metricDefinitions.label: Common route quality
metricDefinitions.definition: distance/50 + time/90 + modeled battery percentage points/30 + 0.25*terrain exposure/20. Lower is better among feasible routes. New PSO ACO and proposal use this same preference.

metricDefinitions.label: Repeated trials
metricDefinitions.definition: Each method receives the same case and seed in each repetition. Repetitions share an underlying map and are not independent maps.

metricDefinitions.label: Prediction residuals
metricDefinitions.definition: Executed destination time or modeled battery use minus its planned prediction. Positive means underprediction. Simulation consistency only; no external electrical calibration.

metricDefinitions.label: Search progress
metricDefinitions.definition: Observed best feasible score improvements by elapsed wall time, including charged A* initialization. No interpolation or manufactured intermediate iterations.
